messages:
elena: Heads-up: short embargo on the release train for a prioritized kernel hotfix affecting GC stability on some GPU nodes. Holding all non-urgent deploys for ~24h while we roll and validate.

marc: Which clusters are in scope? Is this global?

elena: Targeted: us-east-2 GPU racks that serve the model-router pool. Not full-global but treat as high priority for the train.

brandon: Symptoms observed: elevated P95 and intermittent container OOMs under high-batch embedding traffic, looks like GC pause amplification. Pausing canary promotions for affected groups.

release-bot: Canary group 'gpu-canary-east' flagged PAUSED by brandon at 2026-05-08T09:12Z.

priya: Proposed plan: patch one rack, run 30m soak with production-like embed/search load, then proceed with staggered roll (2 racks / 25m). @ops-oncall can you run the validation checklist and post health snapshots?

ops-oncall: Starting patch on first rack now. Will share perf + mem deltas after 30m. Posting checklist here once run completes.

elena: Exception process for critical urgent fixes during embargo:
```
/permit-deploy TRAIN-HOTFIX --pr <URL> --reason "urgent prod OOM" --approvers @eng-sre @release-mgr
```
Include rollback SHA and smoke-test commands.

marc: Short-term mitigations: throttle embeddings route (/v1/embed) to ~25 rps for the canary group, temporarily disable batch-coalescer for heavy clients, and reduce client-side max_batch to 64 where possible.

brandon: Agreed. I'll apply soft throttles to gpu-canary-east and push a feature-flag to disable non-critical fanouts.

ops-oncall: First rack patched, beginning 30m validation run. Initial graphs show memory RSS volatility decreased ~18% and no OOMs so far.

priya: Nice. We'll continue the staggered roll if validation stays green. After full-roll, require 2h of stability before re-enabling canary promotions.

elena: Confirmed. Freeze calendar updated and auto-unfreeze disabled. Thanks team 12; please escalate any regressions here and add a brief note to the postmortem after rollout completes.
